name: Northern Lights
yield_notes: Roughly 400-500 g/m2 indoors (Sensi Seeds); one Sensi grow report harvested 82 g from a single plant.
terpene_notes: Myrcene and pinene forward; sweet-spicy, earthy pine.
effect_notes: Relaxed, body-focused; the classic heavy indica couch-settler.
notes: Sources vary on flowering: Sensi states 45-50 days, grower consensus runs 7-9 weeks (45-63), and one documented Sensi grow ran 77 days. Compact and beginner friendly.

name: Amnesia Haze
terpene_notes: Terpinolene and citrus; earthy, lemon-peel Haze aroma.
notes: Sources vary: Barney's Farm cites about 75 days indoors; grower databases list about 81; forum harvests land 82-83 days. Stretchy sativa - plan headroom.

name: Blue Dream
yield_notes: 500-600 g/m2 indoors; outdoor plants can get very large.
terpene_notes: Myrcene, pinene, caryophyllene; sweet berry and fresh pine.
effect_notes: Gentle cerebral lift with a soft body finish; all-day strain for many.
notes: Clone-only California classic (Blueberry x Super Silver Haze). Sources vary widely: most cite 9-10 weeks, the Santa Cruz cut 8-9, and forum runs to 11 - so the stored range is deliberately wide. Reported 50-75% stretch after flip. No single canonical breeder; provenance is nursery and grower consensus.

name: Gorilla Glue #4
yield_notes: 500-600 g/m2 indoors; very resinous, dense buds.
terpene_notes: Caryophyllene, myrcene, limonene; diesel, chocolate, earth.
effect_notes: Heavy-handed euphoria then deep relaxation; the name is apt.
notes: Also sold as Original Glue / GG4 (Chem Sis x Sour Dubb x Chocolate Diesel). Most sources agree on 8-9 weeks, some list 8-10; ratio reports vary between 60/40 indica-dominant (most common) and 63/37.

name: GG4 Auto
yield_notes: Smaller than the photoperiod cut; autos of this line are moderate yielders.
terpene_notes: Same diesel-chocolate profile as GG4, slightly lighter.
effect_notes: Similar heavy relaxation, a touch quicker to arrive.
notes: Seed-to-harvest: seed-seller listing says about 70 days; grower reports mostly chop 70-84 days. Autos of this line finish around 10-12 weeks total.
